source_snapshot.procedure: Enable mirror mode, prove live ranges/Channel Mode m, then inject mirror_failover at a bracketed address placeholder.
source_snapshot.criteria: Normal service, BMC UCE slot plus mirror-failover record, both indicators off and applicable UEFI slot event.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL; delegates injection but its grep cannot prove mirror mode, live-address membership or failover continuity.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION; live map-derived address, topology, continuity oracle and restoration are mandatory.

old_problem: `0x100004000[mirror range]` is non-executable and unsafe to reuse; controller coverage, continuity, Windows evidence, indicator applicability, recovery and mirror-mode restoration were unbound.
disposition_reason: The placeholder is explicitly a runtime-selected address, not missing command semantics. ED-03 permits a fresh aligned address from the current approved `mc.addMap()` as a material execution parameter; ED-16 requires FAE approval, isolation, recovery and one-shot control. The review case is complete because it rejects stale/example addresses and defines objective failover/continuity/evidence gates, so Pending is removed.
decision_basis: Directly read XLSX Reliability rows 18 and 19 plus same-row DeepSeek fields.
Read historical record 2423 and preserved exact identity/hashes.
Never execute or normalize the bracketed address; derive and re-confirm one aligned address from the current live mirrored range.
Prove Channel Mode m, expected capacity and one target per in-scope controller before injection.
Require actual failover plus bounded workload/health continuity, not a generic mirror keyword.
No BIOS/memory-mode change, address selection, injection, reset, retry or DUT action occurred.

test_case.test_name: Live-map-bound mirrored-memory failover with service continuity
test_case.purpose: For every approved controller in supported mirror mode, inject one mirror-failover event at a fresh proven mirrored address and verify redundancy transfer, continued service, correct records and no fault lights.
required_package: Supported mirrored population/controller coverage and expected capacity
Approved mirror/debug BIOS configuration and restoration
Current live mirrored ranges, alignment rule and owner-approved per-controller address
Continuity workload/health limits, evidence map, backup and recovery
test_case.test_command: A qualified FAE configures the approved mirror population/mode, captures capacity plus full `mc.addMap()`/`mc.dimminfo()` and proves Channel Mode `m`. For the current controller, select one freshly approved aligned address demonstrably inside its active mirrored range; never use `0x100004000[mirror range]` literally. Invoke the package's mirror_failover once while monitoring the approved continuity workload, BMC and console, then collect full Windows/BMC/applicable UEFI and no-light evidence before restoration.
test_case.expected_result: Each approved controller's live mirrored address triggers the package-defined failover; the bounded workload and platform health remain within signed limits; BMC records both correct slot/UCE and mirror failover; applicable UEFI agrees; both fault indicators remain off; mirror configuration and integrity recover as approved.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires fresh live-map membership/alignment proof, complete controller coverage, actual failover, signed continuity data, exact slot records, no-light evidence and restoration/integrity. Placeholder/stale/non-mirrored address, generic logs, workload interruption, crash, lamp assertion, missing target or incomplete recovery is not PASS.
safety_gate: Dedicated backed-up SUT, stable power, independent console and explicit FAE approval.
Capture live map and re-confirm address membership/alignment immediately before one injection.
Stop on map/capacity mismatch, absent failover, service loss, crash, lamp assertion or integrity concern.
No automatic retry, reset, power cycle or address reuse across changed topology.
expected_evidence: Pre/post BIOS mode/capacity and full live map with Channel Mode m
Approved address and mathematical range/alignment membership
One-shot transcript, continuity metrics and BMC failover/UCE slot record
Integrity, configuration restoration and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: On anomaly, preserve independent console/BMC evidence and let the qualified owner follow the approved recovery. Verify memory/data integrity, capacity, mirror state and BIOS baseline before any separately authorized controller or rerun.

source_conflict.reason: The placeholder is treated as a mandatory live-map binding, controller sequence and Windows/indicator oracle are explicit, and `normal` becomes signed continuity metrics.

blocked.reason: Operation, safe address-resolution rule, oracle and recovery are complete; the fresh address and topology are runtime prerequisites.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: Mirror population/controller matrix, current live aligned address, package semantics, continuity limits, oracle, backup/recovery and restoration.
pending.execution_status: REVIEW RESOLVED AS PARAMETERIZED LIVE-MAP RAS TEST; NO DUT ACTION EXECUTED
pending.owner: Memory/platform owner and Intel FAE bind topology/address and execute; end engineer owns verdict.
pending.unlock_condition: Capture and approve the current live map/address and all safety/oracle/recovery inputs immediately before execution.

project_authority: The approved mirror population/BIOS recipe and current Intel live map are authoritative for address selection; the project continuity/RAS map controls acceptance.
